title: Android FrameLayout nested wrap-content width
purpose: Check that a nested wrap-content frame resizes with a child's label and moves the following sibling.
changes: A wrap-content FrameLayout now measures the current widths of its supported children instead of relying on fixed fallback widths.
steps: Find Short and After under Nested wrap-content frame. They should appear next to one another.
Tap Change frame label. Short becomes Longer label and grows; After should move with it without overlapping. Tap again to restore Short.
Turn on Right-to-left layout and repeat. The order should mirror with the controls adjacent. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The nested frame grows and shrinks with its label and the following sibling stays adjacent in both directions.
limits: This covers supported Bhoo child measurement. Complex Android measurement, font and theme behavior and device parity remain unverified.
validation: Rust regression verifies frame width, sibling position, runtime label and RTL.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified nested width, adjacent sibling and RTL.
